about: The domain events a scenario may assert (event, noEvent). Each names its source: the domain model (docs/lead-delivery/README.md §7), RFC-007 §5.3, RFC-008, or 'contracts' for a name these scenarios introduce that RFC-008 should adopt.

ConversationHandled.meaning: Intake took a call or chat, lead or not

LeadRecorded.meaning: A lead was recorded with its planned deliveries

DeliveryPlanned.meaning: A delivery was planned for a destination

NotSent.meaning: A delivery was decided against, with a reason

Held.meaning: A delivery is held while its destination is stopped

AttemptMade.meaning: An attempt was started and its outcome recorded

DeliveryGaveUp.meaning: The delivery ran out of attempts

DeliveryCancelled.meaning: A waiting delivery was cancelled, with a reason (RFC-008 §5.2)

DeliveryVerified.meaning: A lookup found the record at the destination (RFC-008 §3.1)

VerificationOverdue.meaning: An accepted record was not found within the set time

LeaseRecovered.meaning: An expired lease was recovered by another worker; if its attempt had started, that attempt became unknown (RFC-008 §5.3)

LeadResent.meaning: An operator resent a lead under the same identity

DesiredStateChanged.meaning: Firm configuration changed a destination's desired state

DestinationHealthChanged.meaning: Delivery changed a destination's observed health

RevisionDrafted.meaning: An operator prepared a change to a destination's routing rule; nothing changes until the firm approves it

RevisionWentLive.meaning: A destination's new revision became live

FallbackUsed.meaning: The hand-off went to the firm's fallback

HandOffExpired.meaning: The window to act passed with no accepted hand-off

HandOffEscalated.meaning: The hand-off was escalated to an operator (RFC-008 §3.2)

HandOffAcknowledged.meaning: A person at the firm acknowledged the lead (RFC-008 §3.1)

ClassificationCorrected.meaning: A classification was superseded by a correction

UsageRated.meaning: A conversation was rated as a charge

UsageCredited.meaning: A credit was added for a conversation (RFC-008 §6.2, §7)

AccessRefused.meaning: A request for another firm's data was refused and audited (RFC-008 §9)
